/v/WhoAmI

From the time we hit kindergarten, we're asked what we want to be when we grow up. When we're small, it's cool stuff like ASTRONAUT! Or PILOT! Or DOLPHIN! Then real life sets in and we realize we're really not certain what we want to be...or even who we really are. If you're like me, you grew up with a few talents but not anything you love enough to do for a living. Maybe you like the idea of traveling but have never been able to do it, yet. Maybe you don't care what you do for a job as long as there's open water somewhere close or a mountain to hike. Maybe you want a new life experience and have questions before you dive in. Maybe something else completely!

You might be asking yourself:

  • Who am I?

  • Where do I fit in?

  • What's important to me? I forgot...or never really knew to begin with.

If questions like these and a vague emptiness about your identity are familiar to you, let's talk about it. Life's so nuts and if it goes all flat on you, it's probably just a case of perspective. With so many possible experiences on this one planet alone, there's no way we won't be able to help each other become the best and most authentic versions of ourselves.

All ages welcome. :D
